name: The Hive Preview (dev only)

do.objective: The pens are awake: one Resonant alone, three together, one with company

intro.title: THE HIVE PREVIEW
lines: The new creatures, looks and mechanics of Acts C and D, before any map is built on them.
Every weapon. Nothing runs out. You cannot die. F8 slows the game.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: THE THROAT, C2M17: a gorge of folded flesh-rock with amber veins and a red sun behind the Hive tower. Judge: a place, or a brown room?

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: THE NERVE CATHEDRAL, C2M18: a black lattice of pink nerves over a glowing red void. Judge: does it read as a lattice you cross, not a wall you pass?

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: THE BONE LOOM, C2M19: bone woven like basketwork, cream and old gold, warm light. Judge: a loom, or wallpaper?

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: THE VEIN RAIL, C2M20: iron plate over red muscle with blue vessels, a deck of diamond tread. Judge: a place a train runs through?

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: THE PULSE FOUNDRY, C2M21: copper panels and orange portholes, a grate that glows from beneath. Judge: heat, and the room the Resonants live in?

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: THE MOURNING HALLS, C2M22: ash-white plaster, black cloth hung in scallops, almost no colour. Judge: quiet and grief, or an empty gallery?

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: THE REPRISE, C2M23: the quay as the Hive remembers it, in glass, under two suns. Judge: wrong in a way you can feel, or a blue room?

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: CHOIR OF ONE, C2M24: pale nerve-white stone, rows of seats, a ring of pink lamps. Judge: a hall built for a choir?

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: THE DESCENT, C2M25: black wet stone, copper going green, a well. Judge: is it a different kind of dark from the Deep?

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: THE SILENT ROOTS, C2M26: wood, pale dead moss, loam: no green anywhere. Judge: a forest that is dead, or a brown cave?

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: THE FAULT LINE, C2M27: split basalt, copper light welling up in the cracks. Judge: a place about to fall?

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: THE LAST TIDE, C2M28: a round dock: lime line, weed, drowned oak, a mooring ring. Judge: the harbour again, or something else?

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: INSIDE THE BELL, C2M29: bronze plates, verdigris, roots stitched through them, one copper glow. Judge: the inside of a bell?

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: THE UNRUNG GATE, C2M30: pale dim marble, one gold line, a path worn down the middle. Judge: the end of the road, or a corridor?

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: RESONANT, asleep (left) and a sponge (right): 420 hp, slow, three bodies fused at the hip, a ring of bells welded round the waist. Judge the outline, the colour, the hit volume.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: THE PENS (lever, south wall): one Resonant alone, three together, one with two Tollbearers. A ring every beat: 5 x (1 + company), 20 at most. A metre up, it passes under.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: HIVE CANTOR, asleep (left). 1500 hp, hovering, arms out, ten fingers. It never walks. Its fight is in HIVEBOSS: a double ring that returns, on the beat.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: A sponge over its podium; the threads run to the choir. It takes 5% while the six singers stand, more with each one that falls (they stand up after 5 s). Shoot the singers first.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: THE CLAPPER: a bronze cage round a copper heart, wound in black root, hung from the dome. Asleep (left), still (middle): look at it. The right one swings: lead it.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: ROOT ANCHORS: four pin the chain in the fight. While one stands the clapper takes 30% of a hit; each one cut lowers it and widens the swing. The real fight is in HIVEBOSS.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: THE SCENERY, over the walls: tower, ganglion, reactor, crystal tower (north); root column, shaft, rails (south). In the maps they stand far off; look at each from here.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: THE LINEUP: every creature in the game at true scale, as sponges: shortest first, then the bosses, then the nodes. Judge the new against the old: outline, height, colour.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: THE VARIANTS (the near row): plain, Drowned, Hived, Woven, Crystal. A tint on the same rig and nothing else. Is each a different creature, or a tint too far?

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: THE HIVE PREVIEW (dev): N the 14 looks, W the bestiary, E the scenery, S the lineup and the exit. More in the picker: HIVEBOSS, BELLBOSS, HIVEEND, HIVEYARDS, HIVEDARK.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: THE EXIT is south of here: it goes back to the title.

objective: HIVE PREVIEW: looks north, bestiary west, scenery east, lineup south
